GRADES 7–8

TEACHER DESK

A classroom gallery with context.

The 49 included artists come from the four supplied bulletin-board photos, with the teacher’s requested exclusions applied. This is a separate Grade 7–8 site. It has no student accounts, ads, uploads, remote media, or outgoing clickable links.

Students use historical evidence, visual observation, and reasoned interpretation. Impact sections are educational synthesis, not claims that one artist single-handedly caused a social change. Representative bodies of work are identified when no reliable fame ranking or creation date was established.

This teacher-curated Canadian classroom collection includes public-domain/licensed images and copyrighted images assessed for educational fair dealing. Copyright stays with the respective rights holders; educational use is not an open licence. The original artwork target is ten distinct works per artist; six galleries now contain nine selected works following the teacher’s requested removals. Any shortfalls are reported in the coverage table below; written studies are not counted as images. The credit/source addresses below are plain text. All current artwork images and portraits have been visually reviewed for the classroom’s no-nudity/no-violence rule, including background details. School-appropriate alternatives replace excluded famous works.

Completed challenges and comparison choices last in this tab’s session storage. There are no student writing fields, uploads, or teacher dashboard.

Read-aloud uses installed local English voices only. Availability and pronunciation vary. This site does not restrict the browser’s address bar; use the school’s guided-access settings when needed.
